StartEditingHint: opens the first photo to do
NoFolder: Choose an order folder on the left.
NoPhotos: There are no photos in this folder.
RemovableWarning: This folder is on a removable drive. For safety, copy the order to a local folder and work on the copy.
OriginalsNote: Originals are kept until Finish order
LowResWarning: Low resolution for this print size
VeryLowResWarning: Very low resolution for this print size
SaveAndNextHint: saves this crop, then opens the next
OrderEnd: This was the last photo of the order.
ErrFileMissing: The photo no longer exists. It may have been moved or deleted.
ErrChangedExternally: The photo was changed by another program after it was opened. Go back to the folder and open it again.
ErrReadOnlyFile: The photo is read-only. Remove the read-only setting or work on a copy.
ErrAccessDenied: PhotoX cannot write to this folder. Check the permissions or copy the order to a local folder.
ErrDiskFull: There is not enough free disk space to save.
ErrSourceUnreadable: The original photo could not be read: {0}
ErrVerifyFailed: The saved file could not be checked, so the photo was left unchanged.
ErrWriteFailed: Saving failed and the photo was left unchanged. ({0})
ErrCorrupt: The file is damaged or is not a valid image.
ErrHeic: HEIC/HEIF photos are not supported yet. Export them as JPEG on the phone or computer.
ErrUnsupported: Only JPEG and PNG photos are supported.
ErrTooLarge: This photo is too large (over 210 megapixels).
ErrMemory: There is not enough memory to open this very large photo.
IdComingSoon: The ID Photo Creator will be available in version 0.3.0.
